name: Omalauncher
author: Simon Schubert
description: Omalauncher's OWL widgets on the desktop: your widget board, the widget store, and an agent to create new ones.

barWidget.description: The Omalauncher mark; click for your widget board and the store in a panel, right-click to create a widget with your agent.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: The board keeps the phone's six columns: a wider panel has bigger tiles.

schema.label: Panel height
schema.description: At most the screen's height; a taller board scrolls.
